note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with HS codes and BOL numbers — this is a real, active exporter of bearing bushes/shells and bearing assemblies (HS 84833000), which matches two of the three declared HS codes (848330; 848390). Declared HS 731815 (screws/bolts) was NOT observed in any visible shipment row; the visible export trade is concentrated in 84833000, so the HS set should be treated as partially unverified rather than corrected outright. The company also imports bearing metal tin alloy ingots (HS 80011090) from ECKA Granules Germany — i.e. it is a manufacturer working on imported raw material, not a pure trader. Domestic supply evidence could not be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403, eximpedia and volza returned HTTP 403, and the DuckDuckGo search backend was unreachable ('Connection refused') for the whole session, so no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or annual-report split could be checked. Domestic status is therefore 'unknown' (not 'none_found') — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not a finding. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public on the free views; not invented. No rejection grounds: the entity clearly exists and is actively trading.
